shots.visual: An ornate jade cup shatters violently on the cold marble floor of an imperial palace.

lines.speaker: cao_pi
lines.text: 朕的天下，要毀在劉備手上？！

shots.visual: An arrogant young emperor paces furiously in his hall, chest heaving with extreme rage.

lines.speaker: cao_pi
lines.text: 一夜之間，宛城竟然失守！

shots.visual: Close-up of the emperor's clenched fist shaking with intense paranoia and fury.

lines.speaker: cao_pi
lines.text: 這大耳賊……到底用了什麼邪術？

shots.visual: The emperor turns around sharply, gesturing commandingly toward the palace exit.

lines.speaker: cao_pi
lines.text: 去旨！請司馬仲達出山！

shots.visual: Wide shot of a quiet, dimly lit ancient study filled with bamboo scrolls and maps.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 隱居多年的司馬懿，接到密旨。

shots.visual: A pair of weathered hands unrolls a strategic tactical map of Wancheng under candlelight.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 司馬懿看戰報，倒吸一口涼氣。

shots.visual: A mysterious strategist in dark robes sits in shadows, a subtle smile of intrigue on his face.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 「繞道切糧，非人所能及也。」

shots.visual: Extreme close-up of sharp eyes glinting in the dark with deep wariness.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 劉備……你背後必有神人指點！

shots.visual: In a grand imperial hall, a calm warlord stands on the left, conferring with a minister on the right.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 宛城已下，曹丕坐不住了。

shots.visual: A wise strategist holding a feather fan smiles with composed confidence.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 主公英明，魏軍內部必大亂。

shots.visual: The warlord's face remains placid, his gaze calculating and profound.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 曹丕定會請出司馬懿。

shots.visual: The minister stops fanning himself, eyes widening slightly in admiration and shock.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 主公連司馬懿出山都算到了？

shots.visual: The warlord smirks with ruthless assurance and sharp, dangerous intensity.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 這一次，我要讓他有來無回。

shots.visual: The emperor stands before a large military sandbox, raising an imperial tally.

lines.speaker: cao_pi
lines.text: 全軍聽令，聽憑司馬總督調遣！

shots.visual: The emperor grits his teeth, eyes burning with desperate aggression.

lines.speaker: cao_pi
lines.text: 務必將劉備的人頭提來見朕！

shots.visual: Inside a dim war tent at night, the warlord stands studying tactical markers on a table.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 傳令下去，全軍就地固守。

shots.visual: The minister looks slightly surprised by the sudden order to hold position.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 不趁勝追擊，直取洛陽？

shots.visual: The warlord turns his head slowly, a cold, knowing smile flickering on his face.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 司馬懿多疑，誘餌已經撒下了。

shots.visual: A hand wearing a dark sleeve firmly places a black chess piece onto a war board.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 司馬懿親自督軍，星夜趕往前線。

shots.visual: A finger slowly traces the river contours of a leather battlefield map.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 「劉備，你藏著驚天秘密……」

shots.visual: Extreme close-up of dark eyes looking straight up in a dramatic tension freeze-frame.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 「我一定要把它挖出來！」
